title: plasmashell crashes in QSortFilterProxyModel::canFetchMore() when quickly dragging a taskbar icon while something's playing video/audio
line: Plasma no longer crashes when you drag Task Manager icons around and then hover a grouped task.
explanation: When a task is hovered, Task.qml stores tasksModel.makeModelIndex(index) in the tooltip's rootIndex. That is a plain QModelIndex whose internal pointer is a QSortFilterProxyModel mapping; dragging tasks reorders the model and frees those mappings, so the stored index goes stale. When the asynchronous group tooltip loader then created its DelegateModel with that rootIndex, canFetchMore() mapped the stale index to the source model and plasmashell segfaulted (the reported stack). The change stores a QPersistentModelIndex instead (makePersistentModelIndex), which the model keeps up to date when tasks move.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: keep the tooltip's task index valid across moves

The tooltip kept a plain model index of the hovered task, which goes
stale when the tasks are moved or regrouped, so loading the group tooltip
later could crash. Use a persistent index, which follows the task.

BUG: 523294

patches.diff:
From 78f267314febb0b67deb7f98e27c55c936c7f597 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 04:25:30 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: keep the tooltip's task index valid
 across moves

The tooltip kept a plain model index of the hovered task, which goes
stale when the tasks are moved or regrouped, so loading the group tooltip
later could crash. Use a persistent index, which follows the task.

BUG: 523294
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..32d59b9973 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -357,7 +357,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
         mainItem.blockingUpdates = (mainItem.isGroup !== model.IsGroupParent); // BUG 464597 Force unload the previous component
 
         mainItem.parentTask = this;
-        mainItem.rootIndex = tasksModel.makeModelIndex(index, -1);
+        mainItem.rootIndex = tasksModel.makePersistentModelIndex(index, -1);
 
         mainItem.appName = Qt.binding(() => model.AppName);
         mainItem.pidParent = Qt.binding(() => model.AppPid);
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: fast task drags followed by hovering the Dolphin and Konsole groups (fake MPRIS player playing). The panel goes black as plasmashell crashes and restarts: 6 crashes in 40 rounds.
With the fix, the same 40-round loop: no crash, and group tooltips keep showing the right windows (another 80 rounds also had no crash).

review.text: Switching mainItem.rootIndex in Task.qml from makeModelIndex() to makePersistentModelIndex() fixes the exact root cause of the QSortFilterProxyModel::canFetchMore() crash when dragging tasks invalidates plain QModelIndex proxy mappings while the async group tooltip Loader incubates its DelegateModel. QPersistentModelIndex automatically tracks moves or invalidates cleanly on removal and converts seamlessly wherever QModelIndex is expected in ToolTipDelegate and ToolTipInstance. The before/after stress-test videos and regression checks convincingly verify the fix.
